verses.sahihInternational: And grain having husks and scented plants.
verses.yusufAli: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
verses.urdu: اور اناج جس کے ساتھ بھس ہوتا ہے اور خوشبودار پھول

verses.sahihInternational: And the winds that blow violently
verses.yusufAli: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
verses.urdu: پھر زور پکڑ کر جھکڑ ہو جاتی ہیں

verses.sahihInternational: And He made them like eaten straw.
verses.yusufAli: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
verses.urdu: تو ان کو ایسا کر دیا جیسے کھایا ہوا بھس
